konu: Future Continuous Tense, Job Interviews, and Professional Documents
ciktilar: E11.1.S2. Ask and answer questions about future arrangements and actions in progress
E11.1.R2. Analyze job advertisements, CVs, and formal letters of intent
E11.1.W1. Understand the structure of professional CVs and letters of intent
hatirla: Future Continuous Tense (subject + will be + V-ing) is used to express activities that will be in progress at a specific moment in the future.
A Curriculum Vitae (CV) highlights educational background, work experience, and core competencies objectively.
A formal Letter of Intent (Cover Letter) introduces the candidate, explains motivation, and aligns qualifications with company goals.

sorular.soru: Match the recruitment terms in the left column with their correct professional definitions.
ciftler: A formal letter explaining applicant motivation and key achievements
A structured summary of education, work history, and skills
Interpersonal qualities such as communication, adaptability, and empathy
Specific technical abilities such as coding, data analysis, or bookkeeping

sorular.soru: Choose the correct sentence in Future Continuous Tense that describes an activity in progress at a specific time tomorrow.
secenekler: At 10 AM tomorrow, our team will be presenting the annual quarterly report.
Our team presents the report yesterday morning.
We have already finished the presentation two days ago.
They are going to the cinema every single weekend.

sorular.soru: During a formal job interview, the interviewer asks: 'How do you handle unexpected deadlines under pressure?' What is the best professional response?
secenekler: I usually ignore urgent tasks and wait until the manager arrives.
I prioritize critical tasks systematically and communicate proactively with the team.
I refuse to work extra hours because deadlines are unnecessary.
I complain to my colleagues loudly about the company workload.

sorular.soru: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb in brackets using Future Continuous Tense.

cumleler.metin: Next Tuesday at 3 PM, our chief engineer ___ (conduct) the final safety inspection at the laboratory.

sorular.soru: Which opening phrase is the most appropriate and formal for a professional Letter of Intent (Cover Letter)?
secenekler: Hey folks, give me that open job right away because I need fast cash.
I am writing to express my strong interest in the Software Developer position advertised on your platform.
What's up everyone, look at my profile and hire me soon.
I don't really care about your company, but I decided to send an email anyway.

sorular.soru: Match the competencies in the left column with the skill classification.
Look at the visual showing components of a job advertisement. What is the fundamental difference between 'Qualifications' and 'Responsibilities'?
secenekler: Qualifications outline required background; responsibilities describe daily duties to perform.
Qualifications mean weekly payment; responsibilities show office holidays.
Both terms mean exactly the same physical equipment provided to workers.
Qualifications are optional suggestions, while responsibilities are forbidden actions.

sorular.soru: Fill in the blank with the correct professional term.

cumleler.metin: A structured document that outlines your educational credentials, professional employment history, and key milestones is called a Curriculum ___

sorular.soru: Which sentence correctly contrasts an instantaneous future decision with an action in progress at a fixed future moment?
secenekler: Someone is ringing the doorbell; I will open it, whereas at 4 PM tomorrow I will be taking my exam.
I will be opening the door right now because the phone rings every minute.
Tomorrow I was attending the meeting when you came into my office.
We are having lunch yesterday at noon.

sorular.soru: Which behavior demonstrates poor etiquette during a remote video job interview?
secenekler: Maintaining respectful eye contact with the camera and testing audio equipment beforehand
Interrupting the interviewer continuously and keeping notifications ringing loudly in the background
Dressing professionally and sitting in a quiet, well-lit workspace
Taking concise notes and thanking the interviewer cordially at the conclusion

sorular.soru: Fill in the blank with the suitable concept.

cumleler.metin: In a formal business letter of intent, concluding the message with 'Sincerely' followed by a handwritten ___ is an essential requirement.

sorular.soru: Why are interpersonal soft skills as essential as technical expertise in the workplace?
sorular.cevap: Because teamwork and clear communication ensure.
